name: Security Desk Visitor Procedure
description: Implements the general visiting-hours cutoff of 8:00 p.m. and visitor photo-ID registration. This procedure is the source for the Visitor Access Training Module.
content: Remind general visitors to leave inpatient wards by 8:00 p.m. unless the nurse in charge authorizes an exception. Before allowing a general visitor beyond the security desk, verify one government-issued photo ID and record the visitor's name, destination, and arrival time. Update these instructions when the visiting-hours or registration rule changes.

name: Visitor Information Sheet
description: Public information sheet reproducing the 8:00 p.m. general visiting-hours cutoff and visitor badge-wearing and return requirements.
content: General visitors must leave inpatient wards by 8:00 p.m. daily, unless the nurse in charge authorizes an exception. General visitors must wear the issued visitor badge above the waist while inside the hospital and return it when leaving.

name: Visitor Access Training Module
description: Training derived from the Security Desk Visitor Procedure. Its demonstrations and assessment questions require review when that procedure changes.
content: Use the current Security Desk Visitor Procedure as the source for staff demonstrations of closing-time reminders and photo-ID registration. When the procedure changes, update the related role-play scenarios and assessment questions.
